inputs.root_cause: Ran the same 10-gate certification-readiness survey used for ipynb earlier this session against safetensors. Found the independent-oracle gate had already been fixed by FF6-EVENT-000275 (fresh, non-stale, exercising real shipped code) and reproducible-build/installed-wheel were already STRONG. The compatibility gate showed 4 tests failing with PackageNotFoundError for the official 'safetensors' PyPI package -- the same '4 pre-existing unrelated safetensors interop failures' noted as background noise in every regression check this entire session. Investigation found this is NOT a real product defect: src/python/safetensors/pyproject.toml's own 'reference' extra comment documents that the official package's import name collides with this repository's own legacy shadow package, so it is deliberately never installed in the shared dev venv -- these tests are meant to run in an isolated environment. But the tests themselves had no graceful skip guard: they hard-failed with an uncaught PackageNotFoundError instead of skipping, so every regression check this session showed 4 FAILED rather than 4 SKIPPED, and the compatibility gate had never actually been verified end-to-end in the correct environment.
inputs.obligation_targeted: Certification gate verification (compatibility), not an SAL obligation -- no obligation_id promoted this slice. Also a test-hygiene fix eliminating persistent false-failure noise.
inputs.acceptance_evidence: reports/certification/safetensors/compatibility-gate.json: 4/4 target interop tests PASS in a real isolated environment (non-editable site-packages install + official safetensors==0.8.0 co-installed), plus 275/276 of the broader shipped-namespace suite passing in the same environment with zero collateral breakage.
inputs.regression_tier: full 6-format regression suite, both before and after the skip-guard fix

execution_steps: 1. Ran the ipynb-pattern 10-gate certification survey against safetensors via a research agent: 2 STRONG (installed-wheel, reproducible-build), 1 STRONG-with-caveat (independent-oracle, confirmed genuinely fixed by FF6-EVENT-000275), 6 PARTIAL (corpus, security, resource, typing, documentation, compatibility), 1 NO_EVIDENCE (performance, matches ipynb).

2. The compatibility gate's PARTIAL rating was specifically because test_official_interop.py/test_obligation_bidirectional_interop.py fail with PackageNotFoundError in the shared dev venv. Read pyproject.toml's own 'reference' extra comment: this is DOCUMENTED, INTENTIONAL isolation, not a gap -- 'Install it in an isolated environment to run the interop tests.'

3. Created an isolated venv at .local/interop-venvs/safetensors (gitignored, throwaway) and installed safetensors==0.8.0, numpy, pytest, hypothesis, plus format-factory-core and format-factory-safetensors as REAL (non-editable) wheel installs -- confirmed empirically that an editable install fails 2 of the 4 target tests (they specifically assert 'site-packages' in the installed package's own file path), while a real wheel install passes all 4.

4. Ran the 4 target tests in this isolated environment: 4/4 PASS. Ran the broader safetensors suite (excluding 7 legacy shadow-package-only test files, out of scope for this shipped-namespace verification): 275 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed -- confirms co-installing the reference package causes no collateral breakage.

5. Wrote reports/certification/safetensors/compatibility-gate.json documenting the environment, install method, and results, matching the existing reproducible-build.json evidence pattern for this format.

6. Fixed the underlying test-hygiene gap: added a module-level skip guard to both test files (checking importlib.metadata.version('safetensors') and calling pytest.skip(allow_module_level=True) on PackageNotFoundError) so the shared dev venv correctly reports these as SKIPPED rather than FAILED -- eliminating the '4 pre-existing unrelated failures' that have appeared in every regression check this entire session as background noise, while still passing cleanly (verified) when run in the correct isolated environment.

7. Verified both environments after the fix: shared dev venv now shows '2 skipped' for these two files (was '4 failed'); isolated venv still shows '4 passed'. Ran the full 6-format regression suite: 3618 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed -- the FIRST zero-failure regression result this entire session.
tests_run: isolated venv: pytest tests/python/safetensors -q (7 legacy shadow-only files excluded) -- 275 passed, 1 skipped
shared dev venv: pytest tests/python/safetensors/test_official_interop.py tests/python/safetensors/test_obligation_bidirectional_interop.py -v -- 2 skipped (was 4 failed before this fix)
shared dev venv: pytest tests/python/nrrd tests/python/ora tests/python/xliff tests/python/ipynb tests/python/safetensors tests/python/ubl -q -- 3618 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed
.venv/Scripts/python -m ruff check <changed test files> -- All checks passed
